thread:
Anya: Hey team — rolling GA for Toolcall Consolidation today at 10:00 PT. This unifies /toolcall/v1 and /toolcall/legacy into a single endpoint with streaming + function-calling. Docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/toolcall-consolidation. TL;DR: new endpoint is /v2/toolcall, accepts tool manifests, supports streaming, and has compatibility flags for old clients. Please read the migration guide and the compatibility notes.

Devin: Nice! What about canary keys and rate limits?

Anya: Canary keys will be created for self-serve orgs flagged in the rollout doc. Rate limits unchanged for GA; we’ll tighten quotas in 2 weeks if no issues. See rollout schedule in the doc (migration -> canary -> staged ramp).

ops-bot: Deploy started to us-east-1 canary pool — job 3921 queued. :rocket:

Maria: Migration checklist for SDKs? Any breaking surface for client libs?

Anya: SDK patches queued: js-sdk PR #502, py-sdk PR #198. Expect npm/pypi releases EOD. Main compatibility: streaming frame adds metadata field `tool_id`. Old clients get a 30-day shim that converts frames. Please avoid relying on shim long-term.

Jordan: Any breaking changes we need to surface to customers (docs/email)?

Anya: Minimal customer-visible breaking changes. We will send a short outbound to active customers with integration tips. Support will get a one-pager with sample requests and rollback steps.

Paul: QA notes — we'll run a test plan across heavy-token streams + tool errors. Sharing test matrix shortly.

qa-bot: QA run scheduled 2612350200 — tests: streaming/long-run, tool-timeout, fallback-compat. Will post results here.

Devin: Ops — what's the fallback policy if model pool hits capacity?

Anya: Fallback will route to mosaic-lite fallback and switch to non-streaming mode for edge cases. Console will show per-route fallback metrics and a fallback_count metric. Ops: set SLO alerts to 5xx spike >1% for 5m and increase anomaly window for the first 24h.

Maria: I updated the migration doc with example requests and a sample manifest. Example snippet: 
```
POST /v2/toolcall
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "prompt": "Summarize this",
  "tools": [{"name":"search","schema":"..."}],
  "stream": true
}
```

Anya: Thanks all. If you need early access keys or want to join the canary cohort DM me. Expect a brief global incident window if we need to rollback — we'll announce immediately and open a release-war-room channel.

Devin: :thumbsup: grabbing canary keys for a couple of customers.

Paul: I'll watch warmup metrics and GPU saturation. Ping if we need extra burst quota.

Anya: Launch checklist complete. Deploying to 10% global traffic at 10:00 PT; 100% by 18:00 PT if checks green. :party_parrot:
